notes: Values in NIS thousand as printed. Columns of the long-term-savings segment note (note 4 / "מידע נוסף אודות פעילויות החברה לפי קבוצות תיקים עיקריות"): total | life insurance (or insurance contracts) | investment contracts | pension | provident; the investment-contract column is used (the receipts row proves the column: total equals the investment-contract cell).
The insurer (מנורה מבטחים ביטוח) is consolidated in מנורה מבטחים החזקות; the note is at group level and investment contracts are sold only by the insurer.
Quarter-end liabilities for yield-dependent investment contracts are taken from the interim balance sheet at every date it prints.

Note on fair-value hierarchy (p.434 of the PDF) prints yield-dependent investment-contract liabilities of 6,964,688 and non-yield-dependent 5,190,276 against 6,964,698 and 5,190,266 in the balance sheet (p.205); the balance-sheet figures are used.
